thread:
Nikhil (PM): short note before tomorrow's groom: post-launch backlog is > 120 items, customers calling out latency and a few billing oddities. propose we normalize onto a tidy cadence: a 1-week "stability sprint" for infra/critical bugs and a separate 3-day micro-polish lane for UX/Docs. agree?
Jules (Eng): agree on lanes. can we surface a compact list of "must-stop" regressions (things causing data loss, errors >= 5% for an org)? that should autoqualify for stability sprint.
Tariq (Support): quick list - top signals: embeddings errors (widely reported), console import duplication, one billing mismatch (customer invoice amount vs portal), streaming re-connect churn. I'll share exact org list in the groom doc.
Rae (SRE): for stability sprint we should require a reproducible case + perf baseline. I suggest this minimal gating: repro steps, load profile, current p50/p95, and an infra mitigation plan.
Lina (Design): micro-polish items I can batch: onboarding copy fixes, retry CTA copy + small animation, help center tweaks. all low-effort, high-perceived polish. bundleable.
Nikhil (PM): propose scoring rule to auto-sort backlog for groom:
- severity (1-4), customers affected (1-3), regression (0/1), effort (1-5)
score = severity*4 + customers*2 + regression*6 - effort
items with score >= 12 -> stability lane, else consider micro-polish if effort <= 3 and customers < 2.
Jules (Eng): sounds fair. will run a quick script to tag current backlog items with that score.
Tariq (Support): will add customer counts and confirm P0 orgs.
Rae (SRE): deployment policy for hotfixes: canary to 5% -> monitor 30m -> if error delta < 0.5% and latency diff < 8% -> ramp. rollback triggers: error delta > 1% or latency diff > 20%.
Nikhil (PM): accepted. I'll add those as checklist items in the ticket template: repro, metrics snapshot, canary plan, rollback guard, owner.
Lina (Design): quick note: for retry CTA variants I can ship A/B copy + follow-up metrics. will attach Figma link in the groom doc.
Jules (Eng): I can own embeddings error triage. might be a config/timeout tuning + small SDK patch. estimate 2-3d.
Tariq (Support): sending a short doc with repros and affected orgs to the meeting thread.
SchedulerBot: Groom session scheduled: "Backlog triage: stability sprint vs micro-polish" Wed 10:00 PT. link: https://calendar.company/evt/3299991234
Nikhil (PM): thanks all. please update tickets before the meeting with any re-scores. goal: ship stability items this sprint, batch micro-polish into next minor release. :rocket:
